protocol: exp6_v5_2 ARCHITECTURE.md: V5 encoder + V5RayDecoder (inherited from v5_final.pt) + HazardHead (seen2scene/futureview/v52_model.py); no flow U-Net

ray.doc: the 64 ray channels of the V4 flow condition are now produced by the V5 CondAdapter; n_points / hidden / feat_ch of the V4 RayEncoder are not used

inference_precision: bf16 autocast for encoder / ray encoder / ray X-Attn / U-Net; float32 attention softmax, projection, decoding and DistP1 (as V2)

v5.retrieval: log-depth strata from one cell to tcap; per stratum the grid cell nearest to the ray among 3 probe cells (integer indexing + gather, no interpolation); outside grid / domain / behind camera / duplicate masked; UNKNOWN in-domain cells kept
v5.coarse: F1 adaptive-average-pooled to 2 x 2 x 2 regions (8 tokens per state)

hazard.doc: intervals uniform in log1p(t / c), c = 16 VS, from tcap * 0.5 / 70 to tcap; rho per S0 of ray length; belief input detached
